summary: VCI Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a court-approved settlement with Esousa Group Holdings, LLC, resolving litigation over breached reporting and registration obligations under securities purchase agreements. Under the settlement, VCI will issue 821,469 ordinary shares, a pre-funded warrant for 401,025 shares, and warrants for up to 4,889,976 shares in exchange for the surrender of original warrants and full exercise of a common B warrant. The issuance is exempt under Section 3(a)(10) of the Securities Act. The filing does not announce a standalone special situation, as it resolves a discrete legal claim through a securities-for-claims exchange, without a broader corporate transaction.
